D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Seth Bodnar runs furthest behind in Fergus, Sanders, Madison. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 71% of voters, 31 to 51, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.54 points; Midsize counties, 61% of voters, 32 to 46, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.05 points; Voters who find daily costs hard to afford, 60% of voters, 34 to 46, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.02 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Seth Bodnar: Immigration voters 12 to 80, Small counties 25 to 58, Men 26 to 56. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
